text.text: You will always be notified when data collection occurs and you’ll be asked for consent.
We collect the data directly when you send us a message via the forms on our website.
We collect the data directly when you voluntarily complete a customer survey or provide feedback on any of our message boards or via email.

We collect the data directly when you voluntarily contact us on by any communication means, be it email, social media or website message boards to inquire about our services or employment opportunities.
We collect the data indirectly when you visit our website; in this case, embedded web technologies known as cookies collect non-identifying personal data.
